source: Hit points and sizes from hollow-orbit js/game/items.js DEPLOY; slots from Rust (boxes 18 and 48; the furnace's fuel, two inputs and three outputs as RustMVP's interface lays them out); the sleeping bag's 300 s cooldown from RustMVP inventory_survival.md §9 (and Rust), the bed's 120 s from hollow-orbit and Rust. Sizes are half extents in metres (x across, y up, z along). Fuel burn and cooking times are on the items. G6 (ours): the vehicle workbench's size from its model (PSG Starter Kit); its 'bay' is where a ship it builds rolls out (in its own frame: x across, z out of its front) and the space that must be clear there. G7: the research table (Rust's item and scrap slots, and one for the blueprint it makes; what it does is in world.json). P2 (GROUND_SYSTEMS.md §6): each one's placement rule is placement.json's deployable rule with its own 'placement' block on top (the steepest ground it stands on, RustMVP's 128 sleeping bags a player). P1: pickup, picked back up as its item with E when empty, where the player has building rights (Rust's; GROUND_SYSTEMS.md §11.3). IW4: burns, what an incendiary fire burns (IRON_WAKE.md §7): the wooden and cloth ones (bags, beds, boxes, the wooden workbench); the campfire's stones, the furnace and the metal benches don't.
